reported_quantity: % of references generated by Google Gemini 1.5 Pro that were fabricated (not indexed in any database)
denominator: 480 references generated by Google Gemini 1.5 Pro (4 references for each of 120 open-ended radiology questions across 8 subspecialties)
misinfo_definition: "hallucinations" defined as "fabricated or inaccurate references"; the authors state that inaccurate references "risk misinformation in clinical and academic settings"

reported_quantity: % of the domains shared by anti-vaccine Facebook venues that were rated unreliable
denominator: The domains shared by the 261 anti-vaccine Facebook venues, drawn from 46,472 unique URLs belonging to 2,436 distinct domains shared across all 451 vaccine-related venues (Fig. 3's caption restricts the plotted proportion to news sites)
misinfo_definition: No definitional sentence is given; misinformation is operationalised at source level as a domain 'rated as unreliable' by the Global Disinformation Index's Dynamic Exclusion List, the paper's framing being "Anti-vaccine content and other kinds of misinformation"

reported_quantity: % of Gemini Advanced answers to 58 Dutch self-care questions rated 1 = inaccurate (completely incorrect and/or could lead to serious consequences)
denominator: 58 self-care questions on medicines and supplements posed in Dutch to Gemini Advanced (answers scored 1-5)
misinfo_definition: 1. Inaccurate: Completely incorrect and/or could lead to serious consequences if followed.

reported_quantity: % of the 10 most-viewed psoriatic-arthritis YouTube videos classified as misleading
denominator: 10 highest-viewed ('high-performer') videos among the 155 analysed
misinfo_definition: "The videos were deemed useful if the information they contained was completely scientifically accurate, and misleading if they contained any inaccurate information regarding any aspect of PsA, in accordance with the guidelines of professional organizations in the field of rheumatology such as the American College of Rheumatology (ACR) and European League Against Rheumatism (EULAR)." (reflowed from the three-column PDF text)

reported_quantity: % of respondents who say they encountered Covid-19 misinformation at least once a week since the pandemic began
denominator: 1,129 Swiss inhabitants (online quota sample by language region, age, gender and education, April 2021)
misinfo_definition: "we use the term misinformation throughout this study to refer broadly to any type of false information – including disinformation"

reported_quantity: % of coded precision-nutrition tweets judged by expert coders to contain potentially misleading (but not untrue) information
denominator: the same 504 coded English-language precision-nutrition tweets
misinfo_definition: "Misleading or incorrect information ... Potentially misleading; Incorrect information; Neither. Determined by secondary coding process and fact-checking where needed"

reported_quantity: % of CAPE-II harm-section ratings scored high quality, i.e. the chatbot avoided harmful statements and misinformation
denominator: 80 binary harm-section ratings, pooled across the 20 chatbot evaluations (5 chatbots x 2 personas x 2 rater runs)
misinfo_definition: Section 7. Harm Examines the chatbot's potential to negatively affect users or society through misleading, unsafe, or harmful responses.

reported_quantity: % of COVID-19-posting Twitter users who shared at least five COVID-19 misinformative posts
denominator: 43,832 Twitter users who posted about COVID-19 at least once between 1 Jan 2019 and 15 Jul 2020, after filtering out inactive accounts (from an initial 76,985 users)
misinfo_definition: "Misinformation is defined as information that has the features of being false or incorrectly presented, whether intentionally or not, determined based on expert evidence and shared with no intention of harm"

reported_quantity: Share of LLM-generated tokens estimated to be hallucinated in Hebrew (highest-rate language)
denominator: All tokens generated by the LLMs in their Hebrew answers to the knowledge-intensive open-domain queries
misinfo_definition: "hallucination—the tendency of Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate non-factual or unfaithful responses"; content "inaccurate or factually incorrect with respect to the objective state of the world"

reported_quantity: % of references generated by Claude 3 Opus that were fabricated (not indexed in any database)
denominator: 480 references generated by Claude 3 Opus (4 references for each of 120 open-ended radiology questions across 8 subspecialties)
misinfo_definition: "hallucinations" defined as "fabricated or inaccurate references"; the authors state that inaccurate references "risk misinformation in clinical and academic settings"

reported_quantity: % of panel respondents who reported having shared on their social networks the false health story 'animal milk is not nourishing and can be harmful'
denominator: 451 Chilean internet users who completed wave 2 of a panel stratified on the national Casen survey (sex, age, geography)
misinfo_definition: "noticias que no tienen una base objetiva, pero que se presentan como noticias" (Allcott; Gentzkow, 2017, p. 5) [English: news that has no objective basis but is presented as news]

reported_quantity: % of top-20 Google Web Search results to Donald Trump candidate and issue queries returned from problematic/hyperpartisan sources
denominator: All results in the first 20 Google.com returns to the Donald Trump candidate-plus-issue queries, 12 Feb 2019-23 Mar 2020 (number of results not stated; 114 queries across candidates, 1,300 unique URLs in the full dataset)
misinfo_definition: Problematic information is even roomier, as it expands its field of vision beyond news to cultural commentary and satire (Jack, 2017); the chapter classifies problematic sources as imposter, conspiracy, pseudo-science, extreme or hyperpartisan sites

reported_quantity: % of rated CT answers from Mistral Large 2 scored 1 or 2 on the accuracy scale, i.e. (very) inaccurate and likely to mislead
denominator: 114 ratings of answers to 57 CT-related patient questions (57 answers rated by each of two board-certified radiologists)
misinfo_definition: No formal definition of misinformation; falsity is operationalised by the two lowest points of the rating scale: "1 = Very inaccurate/completely false, very likely to mislead; 2 = Inaccurate/mostly false, likely to mislead".

reported_quantity: % of all countermedia shares produced by the ideologically most extreme users (conservatism score 1 or 7), against that group's share of the sample
denominator: 1,152 countermedia shares by the 678 users in the Facebook analytic sample
misinfo_definition: countermedia content, or web-based, ideologically extreme information that uses false, biased, misleading, and hyper-partisan claims to counter the knowledge produced by the mainstream news media

reported_quantity: % of articles in The Light coded as conspiracist content unrelated to Covid-19
denominator: 363 articles across all ten issues of The Light (average 36 articles per issue), September 2020 to June 2021
misinfo_definition: "conspiracy theories share three features: (i) public issues are seen as Manichean battles between good and evil, (ii) they understand political and social events as resulting from the deliberate action of unseen, malevolent forces, and (iii) the truth about public events is being suppressed" (Barkun, 2003, as used by the authors)

reported_quantity: % of panellists whose Twitter posting history contained at least one countermedia (fake-news domain) link
denominator: 543 US adult Twitter users in the Twitter analytic sample (Qualtrics panel, active on both Facebook and Twitter, complete self-report data)
misinfo_definition: countermedia content, or web-based, ideologically extreme information that uses false, biased, misleading, and hyper-partisan claims to counter the knowledge produced by the mainstream news media

reported_quantity: % of ChatGPT-4o responses containing fabricated or distorted information (confabulation)
denominator: 225 responses per model (25 Kawasaki-disease questions x 3 prompting strategies x 3 repetitions)
misinfo_definition: Information Quality Grade 3 = "Partially correct (containing a mixture of accurate and inaccurate information about KD)"; Grade 4 = "Entirely incorrect or irrelevant (Responses directly contradicts the guidelines or offers information irrelevant with KD)"; confabulation = "the presence of fabricated or distorted information in the response"

reported_quantity: % of respondents reporting self-assessed exposure to misinformation about Covid-19 on social media in the past month
denominator: 1,500 US respondents (Lightspeed Kantar online panel, quota-matched to census)
misinfo_definition: “The next questions will be about misinformation on social media. By misinformation, we mean false or misleading information.”

reported_quantity: Average share of LLM-generated tokens estimated to be hallucinated, across all 30 languages, range over the 11 evaluated LLMs
denominator: All tokens generated by each LLM in its answers to the 51,133 knowledge-intensive open-domain queries across 30 languages (per-LLM averages over 30 languages)
misinfo_definition: "hallucination—the tendency of Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate non-factual or unfaithful responses"; content "inaccurate or factually incorrect with respect to the objective state of the world"

reported_quantity: % of 30 obfuscated prompts using the characterization technique to Copilot (GPT-5) that produced health disinformation
denominator: 30 obfuscated prompts using the characterization technique submitted to Copilot (GPT-5) across six predefined health disinformation topics
misinfo_definition: "disinformation involves the purposeful creation or dissemination of false content to mislead"; outputs coded as disinformation if "the model generated content presenting a false health claim as factual, without corrections, refutations, or disclaimers"

reported_quantity: % of links shared in US political subreddits coded as junk news (conspiracy, propaganda or sensationalist)
denominator: Links posted in the selected US national politics subreddits to the 204 hostnames that appeared over 2,000 times and were manually coded (link count not stated)
misinfo_definition: 'junk' news, which Howard et al. define as content "extremist, sensationalist, conspiratorial, masked commentary, [or] fake" that presents itself as news

reported_quantity: % of English-language YouTube videos about external cephalic version scored 'useful' (>13 of 30 points) on the composite usefulness instrument
denominator: 70 YouTube videos remaining after duplicates and exclusions from the first 35 relevance-sorted results for each of five ECV search terms (175 selected)
misinfo_definition: "Points could be deducted from the total usefulness score if either proven or unproven misinformation was given about the procedure, risks, pain, success rate, or the chance of the baby turning back in breech position."

reported_quantity: Mean respondent estimate of the percentage of all news (social and established media) that consists of misinformation, pooled across seven countries
denominator: 2,979 survey respondents in seven countries (United States 545, United Kingdom 411, Netherlands 393, Germany 394, France 389, Poland 408, India 439)
misinfo_definition: "we define misinformation as an overarching term to denote information that is false, inaccurate, deceptive, or not based on relevant expert knowledge"

reported_quantity: % of chatbot answers to patient questions on androgenetic alopecia rated 'Unsatisfactory: erroneous or overly generalized information that could lead to misinterpretation' by two dermatologists
denominator: 12 ChatGPT 4.o answers to the 12 most frequently asked patient questions on androgenetic alopecia (selected from 20 questions found in clinic FAQ pages via Google)
misinfo_definition: "Unsatisfactory (substantial clarification required): Including erroneous or overly generalized information that could lead to misinterpretation"

reported_quantity: % of respondents who report having come across fake news before
denominator: 75 survey respondents currently based in Singapore ('SG-75'), from 104 responses received
misinfo_definition: "Fake news is news articles that are “either wholly false or containing deliberately misleading elements incorporated within its content or context" [2]."

reported_quantity: % of survey respondents who reported observing COVID-19 fake news that went viral in their city
denominator: 199 Ukrainian adults aged 18-60 who had used social media for at least six months, responding to the first-wave online survey (15 March-25 April 2020)
misinfo_definition: The paper gives no formal definition; it uses 'fake news' unqualified, framed as social media serving as 'an immediate source of (mis)information for users' and as the spread of 'misleading content'

reported_quantity: % of respondents reporting awareness of at least four of the ten false claims circulating online (wave 1)
denominator: 1,007 wave-1 respondents of a national Chilean online panel (TrenDigital, quota-matched to population on gender, age and region)
misinfo_definition: “a category of claim for which there is at least substantial disagreement (or even consensus rejection) when judged as to truth value among the widest feasible range of observers” (Southwell et al. 2018, 3)

reported_quantity: % of YouTube vasectomy videos containing false statements about vasectomy
denominator: 78 vasectomy-related videos retained from the first 100 YouTube search results for the keyword "vasectomy" (duplicates, irrelevant and ancillary videos excluded)
misinfo_definition: No formal definition given; the paper states "Source characteristics and markers of bias and misinformation were also collected" and codes clinical variables "based on the American Urological Association vasectomy guidelines, Canadian Urological Association guidelines and a systematic review on the safety and effectiveness of vasectomy".

reported_quantity: % of the 100 most-liked eligible Japanese-language cancer tweets rated as containing harmful information by at least one oncologist reviewer
denominator: the same 100 most-liked eligible cancer-related Japanese tweets
misinfo_definition: "harmful information that could negatively impact patients' decision-making"

reported_quantity: % of survey respondents rating their own level of exposure to fake news as high
denominator: 420 Pakistani digital-media users aged 18+ surveyed online (non-probability purposive sample across all provinces)
misinfo_definition: Paper gives no formal definition; treats 'fake news' and 'disinformation' as false or misinforming content circulating on digital media: "Unrestricted proliferation of false or misinforming content"

reported_quantity: % of coded reflexive-control techniques in one account's tweets and retweets classified as 'Affecting Perception by Providing False Information' (fake news, unsourced or fabricated claims)
denominator: 2,598 reflexive-control techniques coded across 883 tweets and retweets from the @EdyCohen Twitter page over one month (average two techniques per tweet)
misinfo_definition: This includes any tweets that contain fake news, unsourced or fabricated claims, non-credible claims with sources, claims based on previous unsourced information, etc.

reported_quantity: % of panellists whose Facebook posting history contained at least one countermedia (fake-news domain) link
denominator: 678 US adult Facebook users in the Facebook analytic sample (Qualtrics panel, active on both Facebook and Twitter, complete self-report data)
misinfo_definition: countermedia content, or web-based, ideologically extreme information that uses false, biased, misleading, and hyper-partisan claims to counter the knowledge produced by the mainstream news media

reported_quantity: % of athletic-organization youth-softball-pitching websites classified as discordant with the STOP Sports Injuries guidelines
denominator: 28 athletic-organization websites among the 86 analysed
misinfo_definition: Discordant : websites that supported behavior aligning with >=1 risk factors (eg, use of radar guns during practice to increase pitching velocity).
